edicao: Keep the SAME room as the attached panel: the same wall and floor colors, the same light, the cork board with ONLY ONE photo (a single die) and one red string, the same potted plant, and the same Diana (white cat, black-tipped ear, grey brow marks, the same little bandage on the bridge of her nose). Same thick cocoa outline, same flat sticker style. No text or letters anywhere. Change only the moment: Diana sits at a small table with sage-green felt and a few pink dice in the foreground and holds a damp notebook page up in front of her face with both front paws, reading it with narrowed eyes. The page faces HER: we see only the plain cream BACK of the page, blank, with a faint wet stain showing through, and nothing drawn on our side. Her eyes peek over the top edge of the page. The cork board stays visible behind her at the right. The upper-left third of the frame (top 40%) stays empty plain wall, free for a speech balloon.
